subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost’s production WebSocket client enforce a fixed 30-second opening-handshake timeout?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the bound works, but repository evidence cannot determine whether supported slow proxies or self-hosted Mattermost deployments must permit handshakes longer than 30 seconds.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Land the native `ws` timeout as a fixed internal availability boundary matching existing Slack relay and browser CDP precedent.

options.title: Revise the fixed duration
options.body: Choose a different internal timeout and update the regression and standalone proof to that owner-approved boundary.

options.title: Keep unbounded behavior
options.body: Decline the change if Mattermost compatibility requires permitting arbitrarily slow opening handshakes despite the reconnect-loop hang risk.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the native `ws` timeout as a fixed internal availability boundary matching existing Slack relay and browser CDP precedent.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged reconnect work owns the recovery policy that this timeout feeds into.
